decision: Complete bounded source census; no product/gate/audit admission. Focused proof needs identified, not blanket failure findings.

contract.ordinary_export_obligation: docs/03-sass-contract.md:42 covers all historical ordinary/current component mixins. The13 all-legacy ordinary companions in lines49ff are an aggregate membership subset, not a cap on the154 ordinary export obligations.
contract.source_vs_output: Historical ordinary call syntax and independently owned M2 intent must reach current official components. Old ordinary CSS equality is not current integration proof (doc03:45,117).
contract.no_false_negative: A missing direct overrides include is not a failure. Transitive public calls, matching current public tokens, direct CSS, and intentionally empty historical dimensions require individual interpretation.

public_graph.interpretation: The remaining53 public-reachable exports reach public overrides through companion/state helpers. icon-color is the53rd aggregate companion export and emits the already current --mat-icon-color token through owned token-utils instead.

empty_source_bodies.limit: Retained original no-output metadata is not proof that every current state/dimension needs no integration.

concrete_source_observations.owned: styles/checkbox/_checkbox-theme.scss:10 includes owned vendored MDC checkbox.theme, backed by m2/mdc/_checkbox.scss prefix(mdc,checkbox). Vendor checkbox theme prefix is checkbox; it calls keys.declare-custom-properties at line123.
concrete_source_observations.current: Both installed runtime checkbox modules consume --mat-checkbox-selected-icon-color; no literal --mdc-checkbox-selected-icon-color consumer was found in shipped non-testing Material FESM JS.
concrete_source_observations.status: Concrete token-name discrepancy; highest priority focused current checkbox proof. No compile/render failure claimed.

concrete_source_observations.owned: styles/button/_button-theme.scss:41 reaches vendor button-text-theme.theme. Vendor button-text-theme.scss:33 uses text-button prefix and line74 calls keys.declare-custom-properties.
concrete_source_observations.current: Both installed button runtimes consume --mat-button-text-label-text-color, not the old --mdc-text-button-label-text-color.
concrete_source_observations.status: Concrete token-name discrepancy; prove full variant/typography/density path rather than only old ordinary CSS parity.

concrete_source_observations.owned: Owned prefixes(mat,option),(mat,optgroup),(mat,icon) have10/6/1 lexical token keys, respectively.
concrete_source_observations.current: Every one of these names appears as a literal var consumer in both installed peers, including --mat-icon-color used by icon-color despite no public override include.
concrete_source_observations.status: Counterexample to classifying missing overrides as failure. Exact values, scope/state/cascade and public-API boundary still need proof.

concrete_source_observations.owned: color/theme reach the public state helper with exactly three state-layer tokens; typography/density retain separate historical paths.
concrete_source_observations.status: Existing three-token state proof cannot be generalized to every filled/outlined current form-field token or every ordinary form-field dimension.

concrete_source_observations.owned: dialog-legacy-padding emits specific current-looking .mat-mdc-dialog-* selectors; input color/typography wrappers have empty content and density is empty.
concrete_source_observations.status: Direct CSS and transitive/no-output contracts need targeted responsibility/selector checks; neither becomes a required API mirror merely because current peer APIs expose more configuration.
